title: VU#701544: mpc-lib Hardened Derivation Fails to Protect Ancestor Isolation
description: Fireblocks' mpc-lib library has a cryptographic fail-open vulnerability in its BIP32 hardened derivation implementation when the private parent key is missing. This flaw breaks the ancestor isolation property, allowing an attacker with a compromised lower-level signer share and knowledge of the chain code to recover higher-level shares up to the root share. The primary MPC secret-sharing layer still prevents full private key reconstruction from a single share compromise, but the hardened derivation no longer provides defense-in-depth isolation between derivation levels. No vendor fix is currently available, and mitigation involves keeping the chain code secret and auditing derivation paths.
